game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the snow ranger ahead. Then check the armor value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the hold gate by solving code steps involving armor that move the snow ranger forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the hold gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Default Armory' (Week 6 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ice Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
